name: moottwins
title: moottwins
blurb: hashes every one of a handle's mutuals' avatar photos (skipping solid-color and stock icon pfps), pairs up whoever came out visually closest, and writes a mnemonic for each pair from what's actually different — pfp color/brightness, plus bio, account age, or handle domain when the pfps run out of differences. also flags mutuals whose display names alone are easy to mix up. asked for by @thebadcode.com, who kept mixing up mutuals with similar pfps.
